notes: 0.5.x 主打「在线推送真的能看、真的能停」：PowerShell -EncodedCommand 的 CLIXML 进度流以前会原样写进推送日志（实测单次 4.95 MB / 5069 行、吞吐异常），现在只提取正文（错误优先、其次 Message/ToString）、跨块去重、最多保留 40 行，并加 8 MB 兜底上限；stdout 与 stderr 重复的行不再写两遍。版本契约改按「客户端 app 版本」写——首次推送曾退回 <AppRoot>\version，那是 Electron 版本（实测 44.7.0），会把契约污染成两端永远对不上；老格式契约在 JS 与 PowerShell 两侧都只提示一次并忽略。还原按快照类型分流（profile/plugin/session），可展开占位符的文件不再被误跳过；Resolve-AppRoot 探测不存在的盘符不再抛 DriveNotFoundException；WebDAV 读响应体加独立超时；CLI 参数打错字会提示。 0.5.5：后台守护进程不再「窗口看不见就强杀客户端」——强杀改为只有插件自己请求过关闭（点立即推送/拉取、确认自动拉取、更新、还原）时才授权，被动等待只会等并说明原因，避免把收进托盘的客户端静默杀掉。 0.5.6：macOS/Linux 的 Node 引擎补上真正缺的三步——推送会 git add/commit/push（之前只 capture，云端永远没变化）、拉取会 fetch + 快进合并（之前只把本地仓库铺到本机）、宿主版本契约在引擎侧也参与判定（主版本不同拒绝，-AllowVersionDrift 放行）。还原互认：PowerShell 的平铺快照与引擎的 profiles/<name> 布局快照，两边都能互相还原。 0.5.7：修「从 PowerShell 7 环境启动的 DSH 里更新插件永远失败」——子进程 5.1 继承了 PS7 的 PSModulePath，Get-FileHash / Invoke-WebRequest 变成无法识别，旧代码把「算不出 hash」报成「安装包被改动」。现在脚本自愈模块路径、自带 .NET 版 sha256 与 HttpWebRequest 下载兜底，并在真的算不出时给出准确原因；更新前置错误（找不到插件目录 / 清单没有安装包地址）也会写结果文件，面板不再只显示一条日志链接。 0.5.8：把上一版的模块路径自愈也装进 dsh-sync-common.ps1（推送/拉取/还原/备份都 dot-source 它），这样 Compress-Archive / Expand-Archive（插件快照打包与解包）在同一坏环境下也一起恢复；附回归测试：故意把 PSModulePath 设成「PS7 目录在前、5.1 在后」，未修时 Get-FileHash 算不出，修后 sha256 正确、Invoke-WebRequest 与压缩 cmdlet 全部可用。 0.5.9：下载兜底再加一层——Invoke-WebRequest 在某些环境里「能被 Get-Command 找到、但调用当场抛装配错误」，只看命令在不在会直接失败，现在改成 try/catch 后走 .NET；并用本机 HTTP 服务实测了 URL 下载→sha256 校验→安装 的完整链路。 0.6.0：带令牌下载在坏环境下不再静默 401——HttpWebRequest 兜底会把 Authorization 头吞掉（实测），现在直接说明原因与办法；公开 URL 的下载→sha256→安装 全链路已用本机 HTTP 服务实测通过。 0.6.1：修 WebDAV 模式下的严重缺陷——列子目录时解析基准还是用「配置里的目录名」，只要 WebDAV 根带路径前缀（Nextcloud /remote.php/dav/files/<user>、坚果云 /dav、Alist /dav），服务端回的 href 带着前缀就永远对不上，结果子目录一个都列不出来：推送每轮全量重传、拉取只能看到根目录那几个文件。现在列目录与列文件共用同一套基准（取自请求 URL 的真实路径），并容忍反向代理改写前缀。 0.6.3：两处 CLI 层的静默危险动作修掉了——(1) 推送/拉取前先确认「这个目录自己就是仓库根」，否则 git 会一路向上找到外层仓库（实测把用户 home 的 dotfiles 仓库当场撞锁，锁不冲突时就会替用户提交/推送别人的仓库）；(2) restore 不再把拼错的 -SnapshotKind 静默当 profile（那等于「以为在还原插件，实际覆盖了 profile」），也不再把任意空目录当平铺快照（先建一份无用备份、打印「已还原（写入 0 个文件）」才报错）。 0.6.4：加了两道「越界写入」防护（防御纵深）——WebDAV 下载时写入路径来自服务端返回的 href，现在逐段校验（.. / 空段 / 绝对路径 / 盘符 / NUL 全部拒收并记账，且先判路径再发请求）；冲突还原时清单里的 path 若会写出仓库，直接 400 拒绝。实测表明旧版因为「单段 .. 只能写到父目录」并不会真的逃逸，但拒绝要显式，别靠 EISDIR 碰巧兜住。 0.6.5：修了一个会丢配置的严重 bug —— 面板上保存任何设置（哪怕只是切一下「自动推送」开关）都会调用 handleSettings，而它写盘时只给了一份白名单字段，webdavUrl / webdavUser / webdavPass / webdavDir / syncMode 全被当成空串写回，于是 WebDAV 配置被抹掉、模式静默退回 git。现在写盘以磁盘原始 JSON 为底，只覆盖用户真正提交的字段（未知字段也保留）。同时放开「WebDAV 立即下载到空目录」——新机器首次拉取本来就该往空目录里填，之前却报「这个目录不像同步仓库」。 0.6.6：修「自选同步目录」在 macOS / Linux 上完全存不进去的问题。旧代码把路径统一 replace(/\//g, 反斜杠) 再按 Windows 盘符/UNC 正则校验，POSIX 绝对路径（/Users/... 或 /srv/...）于是全被判非法并**静默丢弃**——面板显示保存成功，实际一条都没写。现在校验搬进 runtime/platform.mjs 的 normalizeSyncExtraPaths()（win32 / darwin / linux 分档，可单测），被拒的路径不再静默丢，而是整批 400 并点名是哪几条，宁可不保存也不假装保存。 0.6.7：修「同步内容勾选」在 JS 引擎里完全不生效的问题。PowerShell 的 capture.ps1 / apply.ps1 会读 config-sync-scope.json，但 runtime/sync-engine.mjs 从来没读过（它只被列进「不同步这个文件」的黑名单）。macOS / Linux 没有 PowerShell、只走引擎，于是面板上取消勾选的「全局提示 / Skills / Agent 预设」照样被抓取、照样被铺回本机 —— 排除项形同虚设。现在引擎按同一套语义门控（必需组 profile 钉死开启、组开关、单项排除、坏文件按全勾处理），capture 与 apply 都会报出被跳过的组。 0.6.8：修自选根（config-sync-roots.json）在 JS 引擎侧被完全忽略的两处问题。一是引擎的 capture / apply 只用探测到的 dshHome / appRoot / workspaceHome，custom 永远是空表 —— 自选目录的路径原样以绝对路径进仓库，换机后对方文件指向第一台机器的目录；用户主目录（Documents\deepseek-harness 这类）也不归一，老机器用户名被带过去。二是占位符识别只认 ASCII 名字，中文自选根生成的 {{ROOT:资料}} 既不被识别也不被跳过，目标机直接把字面量写进配置文件。现在引擎读 roots 文件（语义同 PowerShell 的 Get-SyncRoots），并放宽占位符名字到「除花括号/空白外任意字符」。 0.6.9：修「冲突清单损坏后界面既看不见也清不掉」。readConflicts 把「没有文件」和「文件坏了」都当成 null，于是 GET 报告 exists:false（面板显示“没有冲突”），POST 连 action:reset 都在前面被挡住 —— 用户遇到坏清单只能自己去删文件。现在区分损坏：GET 返回 exists:true + broken + error，普通操作 400 明说损坏并提示可重置，重置提前处理且幂等，坏文件本身保留不覆盖。 0.6.10：修「自选目录」形状不兼容。真实文件里 custom 是对象映射 {名字: 路径}（PowerShell 用 [ordered]@{} 写、引擎与面板也按映射收发），但保存路径只按映射遍历：遇到数组形状（手工编辑、旧文件、从别处拷来）就把对象拼成字符串，报出「自选目录要填绝对路径：0 = [object Object]」——既挡住保存，又给了用户一句看不懂的话。现在三种形状都认（映射 / [{name,path}] / [纯路径]，名字取不到的取目录名），逐项校验绝对路径，出错时说清是第几项，不再打印 [object Object]。 0.6.11：修 Windows 侧「全局提示里的绝对路径被原样推上去」。真跑 capture.ps1/apply.ps1 才发现：prompt/AGENTS.md 走的是原样复制（入库不改、落地不展开），而 JS 引擎一直会把工作区路径换成 {{WORKSPACE_HOME}}、落地时再展开，面板也写着「仓库里用占位符」。结果 A 机推上去的 AGENTS.md 到 B 机仍写着 A 机的盘符路径。现在两侧对称：capture 入库前把本机根路径换成占位符（内容不变时照样判「无变化」），apply 展开后再写，若这台机器还没确认某个根则警告跳过、绝不把 {{...}} 字面量写进你的 AGENTS.md。 0.6.12（安全）：拦住浏览器剖面泄漏。审计你本机真实仓库时发现 plugin-data/browser-profiles/edge-cdp 下有 3,696 个文件 / 297.7 MB，含 Login Data（保存的密码库）、Cookies（登录态）、Web Data、Secure Preferences、History；上传门禁只认「文件名白名单 / .env / *.pem / 含 ghp_ 令牌」，这些一个都不匹配，下一次推送就会把它们原样传到云端或 git 远端。三处一起补：上传/下载门禁按路径段黑名单拦截（WEBDAV）、抓取规则直接拒收并在每次 capture 时清掉仓库里历史遗留的那批文件（PowerShell）、macOS/Linux 引擎侧同一份名单；另加单文件 32MB 上限。 0.6.13：修正拦截措辞——0.6.12 加了单文件 32MB 上限后，超过上限的文件会被归进「安全拦截：含令牌或本机私有凭据」，等于把「文件太大」说成「你泄露了令牌」。现在拦截原因分开：secret（真凭据）/ profile（浏览器剖面）/ too-big（体积超限，不是安全问题，并提示该文件更适合 git 模式）。 0.6.14：git 模式补上剖面门禁。此前只挡了 WebDAV 那条路——而 git 模式里 `git add -A` 会把仓库目录里一切新文件收进索引，**提交历史删不干净**，一次误提交就等于把 Login Data / Cookies 永久留在远端。现在提交前按同一份段名名单把剖面文件从索引撤回、写进 .git/info/exclude，并单独提示「浏览器剖面 / 凭据库（含登录态）」；WebDAV 上传前的清扫也同样认这份名单。另：git 模式首次端到端真跑通过（本地 bare 远端，14 个文件真实推送）。 0.6.15：修「你的规则文件会让安全项整份失效」。实测你本机 ~/.dsh/config-sync-extra.json 里存着早先的 50 条排除与 16 项 skipDirs（没有 browser-profiles），而这两个字段是整份替换语义 —— 于是 0.6.12 新加的默认项在这台机器上不生效：browser-profiles 仍会被当成普通插件槽枚举（本机那目录 3,696 个文件 / 297MB），全靠硬判定逐个拦下，白扫 297MB。现在把「安全必需项」（skipDirs: browser-profiles；exclude: browser-profiles / User Data / Login Data / Cookies / Web Data / Local State）与用户可改名单分开，必需项不可覆盖，补齐时会明确提示补了什么。 0.6.16：修「profile 的 yml/json 里本机绝对路径原样跨机搬运」。实测本机 profile\cordis.patch.yml 里有 path: C:\Users\<user>\bin\pwsh7.cmd，而 capture 对这 4 个文件用的是逐字节原样拷、restore 写回也不展开 —— 这条路径到了另一台机器上就是错的（那边没有这个文件，对应工具起不来）。现在 capture 入库前把根路径换成 {{APP_ROOT}} / {{DSH_HOME}} / {{WORKSPACE_HOME}} / {{ROOT:*}}，restore 在 git 模式与快照模式写回前都展开；非路径内容逐字节不变。用真实 ~/.dsh 抓了一遍：cordis.patch.yml 里裸 C:\Users 路径 0 行，占位符 2 行。 0.6.17：修 profile/package.json 里指向本机 home 的本地插件（link:）。实测本机是 "@local/dsh-personal": "link:C:/Users/<user>/AppData/Local/dsh-personal"，capture 只归一 appRoot 下的 link，这条原样入库；apply 也只重写内置名单里的几个目录名。结果是另一台机器 pnpm install 去解析一个不存在的路径，profile 直接装不起来。现在 package.json 也过整表归一（userHome 已是根之一），apply 写回前展开。真实数据复验：入库变成 link:{{ROOT:userHome}}/AppData/Local/dsh-personal，用假 USERPROFILE 跑 restore 展开成 C:/Users/AuditOtherUser/... 。 0.6.18：修「把同步仓库当快照还原」这条路（崩溃后没有本地备份就是它）。用真实配置 + 假用户名实测暴露三处：① settings\dsh-workspaces.json 里的 {{ROOT:userHome}} / {{DSH_HOME}} 被逐字节拷进 ~/.dsh，DSH 读到字面量占位符当路径；② 这份文件还被丢在 ~/.dsh 根，而 DSH 真正读 ~/.dsh\storages\workspace.json —— 文件回来了、工作区却全没了；③ prompt\AGENTS.md 在仓库里，restore 只找平铺的 AGENTS.md，于是提示词一个都没还原。现在 settings 映射表收进 dsh-sync-common.ps1 作单一来源（capture / apply / restore 共用），restore 按表落位并展开占位符，HomeFiles 找不到平铺版会退到 prompt\。顺带修掉我在补丁里误用的 [IO.Path]::GetRelativePath —— Windows PowerShell 5.1 没有这个方法（只有 .NET Core 有），真机上会直接抛错。 0.6.19：补上 apply 漏展开的占位符。用真实仓库铺到一台空机器上实测：apply 铺完 profile\cordis.patch.yml 里还留着 path: {{ROOT:userHome}}/bin/pwsh7.cmd，pnpm-lock.yaml 也有残留 —— 因为 apply 只展开 {{APP_ROOT}} / {{WORKSPACE_HOME}}，而写完后那句守卫也只检查这两个 token，所以 {{DSH_HOME}} / {{ROOT:*}} 一路铺进本机。宿主能把 YAML 读成字符串，但工具路径是字面量占位符，工具起不来；lock 里的 specifier 也会和 package.json 对不上。现在合成 Expand-AllTokens（先 AppRoot 老盘符兜底，再整表展开），守卫改成「任何 {{ 都算失败」。真实载荷 apply 复验：73 个文件铺完，零残留占位符。 0.6.20：并发保护 + 坏配置的容错。两个 capture 同时跑同一个 DSH 目录时，其中一个会撞上文件锁并抛出 .NET 堆栈（实测：WriteAllText "The process cannot access the file ... profile/package.json because it is being used by another process"）—— 真实触发场景就是自动 watcher 在跑、用户又点了面板推送。现在 capture / apply 入口都用命名 Mutex（Local\，进程退出自动释放，崩溃也不留死锁）互斥；拿不到锁时明确打印「另一个同步动作正在进行（同一个 DSH 目录），本次 抓取 没有执行」，退出码 3 —— 不假绿。另测了配置被改坏的情况：config-sync-extra.json 缺括号时按默认规则继续、并原样保留用户文件；dsh-config-sync.json 坏掉时 status 不崩、不吐堆栈。 0.6.21：把上一条的退出码 3 接进面板。0.6.20 让被互斥挡下的那次返回 3，但面板把任何非 0 都当失败：会变红，而且原因是从日志尾巴随便挑一行（实测会挑到「接着执行（二选一）」—— 用户看到的是推送失败 + 一句毫无关系的提示）。现在 3 走独立分支：文案「跳过：另一个同步动作正在进行（不是故障）」，状态记为完成但带 skipped 标记，不再从 tail 猜原因。静态断言盯着这两点（退出码 3 必须 finish(true,…,{skipped:true})、必须有独立文案）。 0.6.22：退出码 3 在后台执行器里会触发自动回滚 —— 这是接上一条时追出来的。post-exit.ps1 原来用 $failed = ($code -ne 0) 判成败，3 被当成失败后 pull 分支会走「失败自动回滚」：git reset --hard 回拉取前 + 用快照还原配置。也就是说，自动 watcher 只要撞上用户手动同步一次，就会把一个健康仓库 reset 回去。现在 $skipped = ($code -eq 3)，$failed 排除它；结果文案是「另一个同步动作正在进行，本次拉取/推送已跳过（不是故障）」，不再写「推送失败」。 0.6.23：退出码 3 传到 sync.ps1 就被压成 1 了。push 分支拿到 capture 的非 0 直接 Die（Die 固定 exit 1），所以"另一个同步在跑"到上一层又变成普通失败；再加上 PowerShell 管道会把子脚本退出码吃掉（实测 post-exit 里 $LASTEXITCODE 拿到 1），整条链需要两个补丁：sync.ps1 遇到 3 时原样 exit 3（webdav 和 git 两个分支都补）；post-exit 除了看退出码，还在输出里认「另一个同步动作正在进行」这句话兜底。真跑验证：sync.ps1 push 在锁被占时退出码 3、输出两句"跳过"、HEAD 不变。 0.6.24：把面板那条包装路径也按真实写法测了。Windows 上在线推送不是直接调 sync.ps1，而是 -EncodedCommand 里包一层 $ErrorActionPreference='Stop' + notesEn: 0.5.x is about making live push readable and honest: the CLIXML progress stream of PowerShell -EncodedCommand used to be written verbatim into the push log (4.95 MB / 5069 lines in one run); it is now reduced to message text (errors first, then Message/ToString), deduplicated across chunks, capped at 40 lines with an 8 MB safety limit, and lines duplicated on stdout and stderr are written once. The host contract is now written from the client app version — first push used to fall back to <AppRoot>\version, which is the Electron version (44.7.0 in practice) and poisoned the contract so the two machines could never match; legacy contracts are reported once and ignored on both the JS and PowerShell sides. Restore dispatches by snapshot kind (profile/plugin/session), files whose placeholders can be expanded are no longer skipped, Resolve-AppRoot no longer throws DriveNotFoundException for absent drives, WebDAV body reads have their own timeout, and mistyped CLI flags are reported. 0.5.5 makes the "no visible window ⇒ kill the client" path explicit: force-killing is only authorized when the plugin itself asked the client to quit (immediate push/pull, confirmed auto-pull, update, restore); passive waits now only wait and say why, so hiding the client to the tray no longer gets it killed. 0.5.6 fills in what the macOS/Linux Node engine was missing: push now runs git add/commit/push (it used to capture only, so the cloud never changed), pull now fetches and fast-forwards before applying, and the host contract gate applies to the engine too (major mismatch blocks unless -AllowVersionDrift). Restore is now interoperable: flat PowerShell snapshots and the engine profiles/<name> layout can be restored by either side. 0.5.7 fixes plugin updates failing forever when DSH was started from a PowerShell 7 session: the 5.1 child inherited PS7 PSModulePath, so Get-FileHash and Invoke-WebRequest were unavailable and the old code reported that as a corrupted package. Scripts now repair the module path, ship a .NET sha256 and an HttpWebRequest download fallback, and report the real reason when hashing is impossible; precondition failures also write the result file so the panel can show them. 0.5.8 applies the same module-path repair inside dsh-sync-common.ps1 (dot-sourced by push/pull/restore/backup), so Compress-Archive and Expand-Archive recover too; a regression test poisons PSModulePath with the PowerShell 7 module directory first and proves Get-FileHash fails before the fix and works after, together with Invoke-WebRequest and the archive cmdlets. 0.5.9 hardens the download fallback: Invoke-WebRequest can be discoverable yet throw at invocation in a mismatched module environment, so the code now try/catches and falls back to .NET; the full URL download to sha256 verify to install chain was exercised against a local HTTP server. 0.6.0 stops token downloads from failing with a bare 401 in a broken module environment: the HttpWebRequest fallback drops the Authorization header (verified), so it now explains the cause and the workaround; the public-URL download to sha256 to install chain is verified against a local HTTP server. 0.6.1 fixes a serious WebDAV bug: directory listing still derived its parse base from the configured directory name, so any WebDAV root with a path prefix (Nextcloud /remote.php/dav/files/<user>, Jiyanguo /dav, Alist /dav) returned hrefs that never matched. Subdirectories were never listed: every push re-uploaded everything and pull only saw root-level files. Directory and file listing now share one base taken from the real request path, with tolerance for reverse-proxy prefix rewrites. 0.6.3 removes two silent hazards in the CLI: push/pull now verify that the target directory is itself the repository root, otherwise git walks up and would operate on an outer repository (verified: it hit the user home dotfiles repo index lock); restore no longer treats a typo in -SnapshotKind as profile, and no longer accepts any empty directory as a flat snapshot (it used to create a useless backup and print "restored (0 files)" before failing). 0.6.4 adds two containment guards: WebDAV download paths come from server-supplied hrefs, so every segment is now validated (dot-dot, empty segment, absolute path, drive letter, NUL are refused and recorded, and the path is checked before any request is made); conflict restore now returns 400 when a list entry would write outside the repo. Testing showed the old code did not actually escape (a single dot-dot name only resolves to the parent directory), but refusal is now explicit instead of relying on EISDIR by accident. 0.6.5 fixes a config-destroying bug: saving any setting from the panel (even just toggling auto-push) went through handleSettings, which wrote only a whitelist of fields, so webdavUrl / webdavUser / webdavPass / webdavDir / syncMode were written back as empty strings and the WebDAV configuration was wiped, silently falling back to git. Settings are now written on top of the raw on-disk JSON so only submitted fields change (unknown fields are preserved too). WebDAV "Download now" into an empty folder is allowed again — a fresh machine is supposed to fill an empty folder, but it was rejected with "this folder does not look like a sync repo". 0.6.6 fixes custom sync folders being impossible to save on macOS or Linux. The old code converted every path to backslashes and validated it with Windows drive/UNC rules, so POSIX absolute paths (/Users/..., /srv/...) were treated as invalid and silently dropped — the panel reported success while nothing was stored. Validation now lives in normalizeSyncExtraPaths() in runtime/platform.mjs (separate rules for win32 / darwin / linux, unit-testable), and rejected paths are no longer dropped silently: the whole save is refused with a 400 that names them. 0.6.7 fixes sync-scope checkboxes having no effect in the JS engine. PowerShell capture.ps1 / apply.ps1 read config-sync-scope.json, but runtime/sync-engine.mjs never did (it only listed that file as "do not sync"). macOS and Linux have no PowerShell and run the engine, so groups unchecked in the panel — global prompts, skills, agent presets — were still captured and still restored, making the exclusions meaningless. The engine now applies the same rules (the required profile group is always on, plus group switches, per-item exclusions, and corrupt files treated as "everything enabled"), and both capture and apply report which groups were skipped. 0.6.8 fixes two ways the JS engine ignored custom roots (config-sync-roots.json). First, capture and apply only used detected dshHome / appRoot / workspaceHome with an always-empty custom map, so custom folder paths went into the repo as raw absolute paths and the other machine ended up pointing at the first machine folders; the user home folder was not normalized either, leaking the old username. Second, placeholder detection only matched ASCII names, so a custom root named in Chinese produced {{ROOT:...}} tokens that were neither recognized nor skipped, and the target machine wrote the literal token into its config. The engine now reads the roots file (same semantics as PowerShell Get-SyncRoots) and accepts any non-brace, non-space character in placeholder names. 0.6.9 fixes a corrupted conflict list being both invisible and impossible to clear. readConflicts treated "no file" and "broken file" as the same null, so GET reported exists:false (the panel said there were no conflicts) and POST rejected even action:reset before reaching it, leaving the user to delete the file by hand. The two cases are now distinguished: GET returns exists:true plus broken and error, other actions return 400 naming the corruption and suggesting a reset, reset is handled first and is idempotent, and the broken file itself is kept rather than overwritten. 0.6.10 fixes custom-root shape handling. In real files custom is an object map (PowerShell writes [ordered]@{}, the engine and panel both read and send that shape), but the save path only iterated the map: an array-shaped file (hand-edited, older, or copied from elsewhere) had each object stringified, so saving failed with "Custom folder must be an absolute path: 0 = [object Object]" — blocking the save and showing the user a meaningless message. All three shapes are now accepted (object map, [{name,path}], plain path array with the folder name as the key), each entry is still validated as an absolute path, and errors name the offending entry instead of printing [object Object]. 0.6.11 fixes machine paths leaking into the prompt files on Windows. Running capture.ps1 and apply.ps1 for real showed prompt/AGENTS.md was copied verbatim both ways (no tokenizing on capture, no expansion on apply), while the JS engine has always replaced the workspace path with {{WORKSPACE_HOME}} and expanded it on apply — and the panel says the repo stores placeholders. So an AGENTS.md pushed from machine A still named A's drive path after machine B pulled it. Both sides are now symmetric: capture replaces this machine's roots with placeholders before writing (still reporting "unchanged" when content matches) and apply expands them, warning and skipping instead of writing a literal {{...}} when a root on this machine is not confirmed yet. 0.6.12 (security): stop browser-profile leakage. Auditing the real repo on this machine found 3,696 files / 297.7 MB under plugin-data/browser-profiles/edge-cdp containing Login Data (the saved-password store), Cookies (session state), Web Data, Secure Preferences and History. The upload gate only matched a filename allowlist, .env, *.pem and GitHub token patterns, so none of these were caught and the next push would have shipped them to the cloud or a git remote. Three layers now block them: a path-segment denylist in the WebDAV gate, capture-side rejection plus a sweep that deletes previously captured copies from the repo (PowerShell), and the same list on the macOS/Linux engine; a 32 MB single-file cap was added too. 0.6.13: fixed interception wording. After the 32 MB single-file cap in 0.6.12, an oversized file was reported as a credential leak ("contains a token or local private credential"), which accuses the user of leaking secrets for what is only a size limit. Reasons are now distinct: secret (real credential), profile (browser profile data) and too-big (size limit, not a security issue, with a hint that such a file belongs in git mode). 0.6.14: closed the browser-profile gap in git mode. Previously only the WebDAV path was guarded, but in git mode `git add -A` stages every new file in the repo and commit history cannot be cleaned, so one wrong commit would leave Login Data and Cookies on the remote forever. The pre-commit gate now unstages profile paths using the same segment denylist, records them in .git/info/exclude and reports them separately as browser-profile/credential-store data. The pre-upload sweep for WebDAV honours the same list, and git mode was exercised end-to-end against a local bare remote for the first time (14 files really pushed). 0.6.15: fixed a hole where a user rules file disables the new safety defaults. This machine's ~/.dsh/config-sync-extra.json already carried an older snapshot (50 exclude patterns, 16 skipDirs without browser-profiles), and both fields are whole-list replacements, so the 0.6.12 defaults never applied: browser-profiles was still enumerated as an ordinary plugin slot (3,696 files / 297 MB on this machine) and only the hard per-file check stopped it, scanning all 297 MB for nothing. Safety-mandatory entries (skipDirs: browser-profiles; exclude: browser-profiles, User Data, Login Data, Cookies, Web Data, Local State) are now separated from the user-editable list, cannot be overridden, and are reported when added. 0.6.16: fixed machine-specific absolute paths inside profile yml/json being copied across machines verbatim. This machine's profile\cordis.patch.yml contains path: C:\Users\<user>\bin\pwsh7.cmd; capture copied those files byte-for-byte and restore wrote them back without expansion, so the path stayed wrong on the second machine (no such file, the tool cannot start). capture now rewrites root paths to {{APP_ROOT}} / {{DSH_HOME}} / {{WORKSPACE_HOME}} / {{ROOT:*}} before committing, and restore expands them for both git and snapshot modes, leaving non-path content byte-identical. A capture against the real ~/.dsh leaves zero raw C:\Users lines and two placeholder lines in cordis.patch.yml. 0.6.17: fixed local plugin links under the user home in profile/package.json. This machine has "@local/dsh-personal": "link:C:/Users/<user>/AppData/Local/dsh-personal"; capture only rewrote appRoot links, so it went into the repo verbatim, and apply only rewrote the built-in plugin names. On another machine pnpm install then resolved a path that does not exist and the profile failed to install. package.json now goes through the full tokenizer (userHome is already a root) and apply expands before writing. Verified against real data: the repo now carries link:{{ROOT:userHome}}/AppData/Local/dsh-personal, and a restore run with a fake USERPROFILE expands it to C:/Users/AuditOtherUser/... 0.6.18: fixed restoring with the sync repo as the snapshot, which is the path you take after a crash when no local backup exists. Real config plus a fake user name exposed three defects: (1) {{ROOT:userHome}} / {{DSH_HOME}} inside settings\dsh-workspaces.json were copied byte-for-byte into ~/.dsh, so DSH read literal placeholders as paths; (2) that file was also dropped at the ~/.dsh root while DSH actually reads ~/.dsh\storages\workspace.json, so the file came back but every workspace disappeared; (3) prompt\AGENTS.md exists in the repo but restore only looked for a flat AGENTS.md, so no prompt was restored at all. The settings map now lives once in dsh-sync-common.ps1 (shared by capture, apply and restore), restore places files by that map and expands placeholders, and HomeFiles falls back to prompt\. Also fixed my own use of [IO.Path]::GetRelativePath, which Windows PowerShell 5.1 does not have (it is .NET Core only) and which threw on a real machine. 0.6.19: closed the placeholders apply never expanded. Applying the real repo onto an empty machine left path: {{ROOT:userHome}}/bin/pwsh7.cmd inside profile\cordis.patch.yml and leftovers in pnpm-lock.yaml, because apply only expanded {{APP_ROOT}} / {{WORKSPACE_HOME}} and its post-write guard checked just those two tokens, so {{DSH_HOME}} / {{ROOT:*}} reached the local machine. The host parses that YAML as a string, but the tool path is a literal placeholder and the tool cannot start; lockfile specifiers also no longer match package.json. Expansion is now one step (AppRoot legacy fallback, then the whole token table) and the guard fails on any remaining {{. Re-verified with the real payload: 73 files applied, zero placeholders left. 0.6.20: concurrency guard and tolerance for broken configs. Two captures against the same DSH home collided on file locks and one threw a .NET stack trace (measured: WriteAllText "The process cannot access the file ... profile/package.json because it is being used by another process") — the real trigger is the auto watcher running while the user presses push in the panel. capture and apply now take a named Mutex (Local\, released automatically on process exit, so a crash cannot leave a deadlock); when it is held they print "another sync action is already running (same DSH home), this capture did not run" and exit 3 instead of pretending success. Also tested broken configs: a malformed config-sync-extra.json falls back to defaults, warns, and leaves the user file untouched; a broken dsh-config-sync.json no longer makes status crash or dump a stack trace. 0.6.21: wired exit code 3 into the panel. 0.6.20 made a mutex-blocked run return 3, but the panel treated any non-zero exit as failure: it turned red and picked an arbitrary line from the log tail as the reason (measured: it picked "then run (either one)"), so the user saw a push failure plus an unrelated hint. Code 3 now takes its own branch: message "Skipped: another sync is already running (not a failure)", recorded as finished with a skipped flag, and no more guessing from the tail. Static assertions guard both points (code 3 must call finish(true,…,{skipped:true}) and must have its own message). 0.6.22: exit code 3 used to trigger the automatic rollback in the background runner — found while following 0.6.21 through. post-exit.ps1 decided success with $failed = ($code -ne 0), so a 3 counted as failure and the pull branch ran its "rollback on failure": git reset --hard to the pre-pull commit plus restoring config from a snapshot. In other words, one collision between the auto watcher and a manual sync would reset a healthy repository. Now $skipped = ($code -eq 3) and $failed excludes it; the result text reads "another sync action is already running, this pull/push was skipped (not a failure)" instead of claiming a push failure. 0.6.23: exit code 3 was flattened to 1 by sync.ps1. Its push branch called Die on any non-zero from capture (Die always exits 1), so "another sync is running" became an ordinary failure one layer up; and PowerShell pipelines swallow a child script exit code (measured: post-exit saw 1). The chain needed two patches: sync.ps1 now exits 3 as-is (both webdav and git branches), and post-exit also recognises the "another sync action is already running" line in the output as a fallback. Verified by a real run: sync.ps1 push exits 3 while the mutex is held, prints both skip lines, and HEAD stays unchanged. 0.6.24: also tested the panel wrapper path the way it is really written. On Windows the live push does not call sync.ps1 directly; it wraps it in -EncodedCommand with $ErrorActionPreference='Stop' and a try/catch whose catch exits 1 — that layer could easily swallow 3 into 1.
